dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Mondstadt's poetry really is a world apart from Natlan's. It's so soft and delicate.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Listening to it is almost like... being enveloped in a gentle breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I guess the only question is... what it all actually means, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Just in time! Can you take a picture of me?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Lemme see... Wow, turned out great! You got the angle and composition just right. Thanks a bunch!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I think I'll put it right next to my bed... Ooh, or hang it on the wall...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Maybe I'll add some pink and blue paper as a backdrop, and a few seashells for the frame. Hehe, it's gonna be awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Oh, and one more thing. Thanks for making this a summer I'll never forget, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: No worries! All that matters now is having fun!
